content: {"praised":["Excellent and powerful adaptation of Shakespeare's play.","Charlton Heston delivers outstanding performance as Mark Antony.","Superb cast and breathtaking locales enhance the film.","Film stays true to historical story.","Director Heston's vision brings compelling tone."],"criticized":["Poor production values and bad acting.","Battle scenes poorly executed and flat.","Inappropriate nudity and groping distracts.","Editing is abysmal and unwatchable.","Acting fails to hold audience attention."]}
